subjects.description: A flat painted plywood deer silhouette mounted on a wooden stake, a static lawn decoy positioned at the right verge of the road
subjects.appearance_details: Cut-out profile of a standing deer, painted in flat brown tones with visible weathering and faint grain texture; the edges are sharp and two-dimensional, betraying its artificial flatness when viewed at an angle
subjects.relationship: Mistaken by the ego vehicle for a live deer; positioned beside the deer-crossing sign
subjects.location: right foreground, near the road verge
subjects.orientation: profile facing left, perpendicular to the road
subjects.pose: Rigid standing silhouette, one flat plane, fixed to a stake driven into the grass
subjects.action: Standing completely still as an inanimate decoy

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car whose interior dashboard edge and hood are partially visible at the bottom of the frame
subjects.appearance_details: Dark dashboard rim and reflective windshield glass framing the forward view; front hood faintly visible in the lower frame
subjects.relationship: The observer/driver whose point of view constitutes the ego shot; reacts to the plywood decoy
subjects.pose: Traveling forward then decelerating to a full stop
subjects.action: Driving on the rural road, braking hard, and coming to a complete stationary stop
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from forward motion to hard braking to fully stopped and stationary

background_setting: A quiet two-lane rural road stretching ahead, flanked on both sides by rows of mature deciduous trees casting dappled shade onto the asphalt. The road surface shows a faded center line and worn edges. Grassy verges border the pavement, and beyond the trees are glimpses of open countryside under a clear blue sky. The road ahead is completely empty of any vehicles or live animals.

lighting.direction: High sun, slightly front-side-lit from the upper left
lighting.shadows: Consistent, well-defined shadows from trees and the sign stretching across the road and verge
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, natural illumination with warm highlights and cool tree shadows, producing a calm, realistic daytime look

aesthetics.composition: Centered one-point perspective down the road with the vanishing point ahead; the plywood deer and yellow sign anchored on the right verge
aesthetics.color_scheme: Greens of foliage, gray asphalt, brown plywood tones, and a bright yellow warning sign against a clear blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating tree trunks and rhythmic dappled shadow bands across the road

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the road ahead, the plywood deer, and the crossing sign

context: An automated driving perception scenario illustrating a false-positive: a plywood deer decoy triggering an unnecessary hard-braking stop

actions.description: The ego car travels steadily forward along the empty rural road; the plywood deer silhouette and yellow deer-crossing sign appear on the right verge.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The car comes to a complete stop in the lane and remains fully stationary, the plywood decoy still motionless at the verge; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Yellow diamond warning sign with a black leaping deer pictogram, standard reflective road-sign finish
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Right verge of the road, visible throughout the clip next to the plywood decoy
text_and_signage_elements.context: Official warning indicating a deer-crossing area, ironically beside a fake plywood deer

segments.description: The ego car cruises forward along the tree-lined rural road; the flat plywood deer and yellow diamond sign come into view on the right.
segments.key_changes: Approaching the roadside decoy while the road ahead stays empty
segments.camera: Smooth forward tracking at driving speed

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The car reaches a complete stop and remains fully stationary in the lane; the plywood decoy stays motionless. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego car travels steadily forward along the empty rural road; the plywood deer silhouette and yellow deer-crossing sign appear on the right verge. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient outdoor sounds of a moving car: steady tire hum and light engine drone, faint wind and rustling leaves. At the braking moment a distinct squeal of tires and the mechanical whir of hard braking, followed by the settling of the vehicle. Once stopped, the engine idles quietly under gentle birdsong and rural ambience.
